sample_unit: questions (each administered to 10 LLMs in English and Persian)

links.outcome: Usability of LLM responses for individuals with limited scientific literacy (5-point Likert)
links.effect: Usability for individuals with limited scientific literacy had the lowest mean score (3.80) among criteria, versus correlation with the question at 4.81.
links.quote: Among evaluated criteria, correlation had the highest mean score (4.81), whereas usability for individuals with limited scientific literacy had the lowest score (3.80).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of LLM periodontal answers for lay patients
links.effect: Usability for limited scientific literacy scored lowest (3.80); the plain language summary says many explanations are too technical for the average person.
links.quote: second, many explanations are too technical and hard for the average person to understand.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the accuracy, readability, and usability of 10 LLMs responding to simulated patient questions in periodontics, but does not test a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
